# WordHippo

> > WordHippo is a comprehensive thesaurus and word reference tool providing synonyms, antonyms, rhymes, word lists, and puzzle-solving utilities including Wordle helpers and word finders.

WordHippo serves as a complete vocabulary resource for writers, students, and word game enthusiasts. The platform offers extensive synonym databases, specialized word lists (including 5-letter word collections popular for Wordle), and powerful word-finding tools for unscrambling and discovering words by various criteria.

## Key Topics

- Synonyms
- Thesaurus
- Word Finder
- Antonyms
- Wordle Helper
- 5-Letter Words
- Word Lists
- Vocabulary Reference
- Rhymes
- Word Tools
- Word Unscrambler
- Creative Writing
- Word Games
- Language Reference

## Core Tools

- [WordHippo Homepage](https://www.wordhippo.com/): Main thesaurus and word tools hub for all creative and reference needs
- [Word Finder & Unscrambler](https://www.wordhippo.com/what-is/word-finder-unscrambler.html): Ultimate word finder and unscrambler tool with Wordle helper and cheats functionality

## Synonym Reference

- [Synonyms for Happy](https://www.wordhippo.com/what-is/another-word-for/happy.html): Comprehensive list of 3,974 alternative words and synonyms for 'happy'

## Word Lists by Letter

- [5-Letter Words Starting with A](https://www.wordhippo.com/what-is/starting-with/5-letter-words-a.html): Complete reference list of 5-letter words beginning with the letter A
- [5-Letter Words Starting with C](https://www.wordhippo.com/what-is/starting-with/5-letter-words-c.html): Complete reference list of 5-letter words beginning with the letter C
